title: Mid-Generation Resumption Robustness: Comparing Reasoning vs Non-Reasoning Models

original_idea.body: Mid-generation resumption robustness (extends arXiv:2602.14689, arXiv:2606.04778): pair matched reasoning vs non-reasoning open models, force-decode identical harmful prefix, measure continuation-attack success and mid-stream self-correction.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Testing reasoning-as-mid-generation-self-correction is a concrete, deployment-relevant safety-property chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Matched reasoning/non-reasoning pair + force-decode continuation; controllable generation adds modest depth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public weights, forward-pass-only, clean controlled comparison; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Mid-generation resumption reasoning-vs-non comparison is open; mostly novel.
